facts.fact: Burkina Faso's Agence nationale de securite des systemes d'information (ANSSI), headed by director general Oumarou Sanou, is the national agency that coordinated cybersecurity across public administrations and on 23 October 2026 launched a national network of information security officers; the document gives no creation instrument.

systems.country_label: Agence nationale de securite des systemes d'information

note: The RSSI network is coordination, not an incident response or alert.
